say:9:1820219005:1.text: Stop whining, Dorina. I went through a lot of trouble to get us <style="highlight">VIP seats</style> for Senea's performance. I didn't do all that just to listen to your endless grumbling.
say:9:1820219005:1.source_cn: 好了，少些抱怨吧，朵蒂娜。我千辛万苦才托人拿到两张<s...

say:10:1820219006:1.text: You should know by now, Demisa, that I loathe everything that comes from the world of the living.
say:10:1820219006:1.source_cn: 那你就该知道，碧翠逝，我对生者的东西向来嗤之以鼻。

say:11:1820219007:1.text: Senea's a Graveborn now. And as for the director and the rest of the cast, they've been dead even longer. I'm sure the revised play will appeal to both Graveborn and the living.
say:11:1820219007:1.source_cn: 塞涅已经不是生者了，海歌剧院的导演和其他演员更是离世得...

say:12:1820219008:1.text: Plus, Senea's performance is all the rage in Novaris right now. Surely you wouldn't want Bridget and the others to think you're out of touch?
say:12:1820219008:1.source_cn: 更何况——诺珐斯如今的潮流就是观看塞涅的演出，交流心得...

say:13:1820219009:1.text: Hmph, I never said I'd skip the show.

say:14:1820219010:1.text: This performance had better be good. Otherwise, I'll have to seriously question Bridget's taste.
say:14:1820219010:1.source_cn: 但愿这场演出能让我满意，否则布莉吉德的品味就要跌入深海了。

say:16:1820219011:3.text: Excuse me... I don't mean to intrude, but how did you get tickets for the VIP seats?
say:16:1820219011:3.source_cn: 不好意思……！我想请问一下，你们手里的贵宾席是怎么买到...

say:17:1820219012:1.text: Ugh, a stowaway... Please leave me alone.
say:17:1820219012:1.source_cn: 啊……偷渡者。麻烦不要和我搭话。

say:19:1820219014:0.text: Now, quit hovering around us. Poor Dorina's feeling sick because of you.
say:19:1820219014:0.source_cn: 好了，别在我们面前乱晃。没看到朵蒂娜都因此头晕了吗？

say:20:1820219015:0.text: <sad>S-So sorry about that! The Graveborn really are scary!</sad>
